{{Nihongo|'''Kōtai Shrine'''|皇大神社|Kōtai jinja}} is a name used by some {{ill|Shinmei shrines|en|Shinmei shrines|qid=Q11590310|lt=Shinmei shrines|1=Shinmei shrines}}

== Main Kōtai Shrine ==  

* {{ill|Tenshō Kōtai Shrine|ja|天照皇大神社 (伊東市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tenshō Kōtai Shrine|1=Tensho-Kotai Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q131925933}} – Shizuoka Prefecture, {{ill|Itō, Shizuoka|en|Itō, Shizuoka|qid=Q721163|lt=Itō|1=Itō, Shizuoka}} Shibamachi: Kusumi Shrine

* {{ill|Obama Kōtai Shrine|ja|小浜皇大神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Obama Kōtai Shrine|1=Kohama Kōtai Shrine|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q11462621}} – Hyōgo Prefecture, {{ill|Takarazuka, Hyōgo|en|Takarazuka, Hyōgo|qid=Q823967|lt=Takarazuka|1=Takarazuka, Hyōgo}} Obama  
* {{ill|Kōtai Shrine (Hiramatsuchō, Nara)|ja|皇大神社 (奈良市平松町)|lt=Kōtai Shrine (Hiramatsuchō, Nara)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Kōtai Shrine (Hiramatsuchō, Nara)|1=Kōtai Shrine (Shijōōji, Nara)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q48754918}} – Nara Prefecture, {{ill|Nara (city)|en|Nara (city)|qid=Q169134|lt=Nara|1=Nara (city)}} Hiramatsuchō
